question:
Select the option that expresses the opposite meaning of the underlined word.

The explosive used is of my own formulation, and I can __vouch__ for its efficiency.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vouch"** means to assert or confirm as a result of one's own experience that something is true or accurately so described. (गवाही देना)

 
 
• **Example: **I can **vouch **for his honesty; he has always been truthful with me.
 
 
 
• **"Invalidate" **refers to something that makes an argument, statement, or theory unsound or erroneous; to disprove or nullify. (अमान्य करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The discovery of new evidence might** invalidate** the previous theory.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'vouch' **is **'invalidate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Maintain **(बनाए रखना): To keep in an existing state; to preserve or retain.

 
 
• **Example:** It's essential to maintain a healthy lifestyle for overall well-being.
 
 
 
• **Certify **(प्रमाणित करना): To confirm or attest, typically in writing; to officially recognize as meeting certain standards.
 
 
• **Example: **The document was certified by a notary public.
 
 
 
• **Witness** (गवाह): Someone who sees an event and can report or give evidence about it.
 
 
• **Example:** She was the only witness to the accident.
